cars.notes:
Current model is the facelift launched 5 Aug 2026, with new Z8S and Z8T trims. Engines are carried over unchanged. Mahindra's site (JS-rendered) only gave the Rs 13.69-25.49 lakh range, so variant prices are CarDekho's lakh figures converted to rupees (rounded to Rs 1,000). They match CarWale's trim ranges except Z4 top (18.02 vs 18.03) and Z8S top (CarWale 19.99 vs CarDekho/Autocar 19.89). Engine kW/rpm figures come from carcentral.in, consistent with Mahindra's older brochure figures (149.14 kW, 128.6 kW, 97 kW); bhp is converted from PS. Autocar quotes petrol power as 203 hp. Diesel displacement is 2198 cc per CarDekho but 2184 cc per Autocar. The 132 PS diesel tune is on Z2 and Z4 manuals per Autocar; the Z4 4WD MT tune is not separately confirmed. Mahindra has published no ARAI mileage for the facelift (Autocar and CarDekho), so mileage is null. Feature conflicts: CarDekho puts the sunroof and wireless Android Auto/CarPlay on Z4, but Autocar puts the sunroof on Z6 and wired connectivity on Z4; Autocar is used here. Z2 screen is 8 inches per Autocar and 9 inches per CarDekho. CarDekho says Level 2 ADAS is AT-only on Z8L, while Autocar says only adaptive cruise control and speed-limit assist are AT-only. Seats: 7, or 6 on Z8L 6-seat variants. Update 21 Oct 2026: mileage filled with pre-facelift ARAI figures (petrol MT 12.17, AT 12.12; diesel MT 15.94, AT 15.42 kmpl) as listed by ZigWheels, Bajaj Finserv, Spinny and Autocar's pre-facelift page, since the engines are carried over; Mahindra has still published no facelift figures (Autocar mileage page, 14 Oct 2026, shows NA). No separate figures exist for 4WD or the 132 PS diesel tune, so the fuel/gearbox figure is applied to them. One Cartoq report gives diesel MT as 15.42 instead. Prices re-checked against CarDekho (all 31 unchanged) and CarWale trim ranges (Mumbai; same conflicts as before: Z4 top 18.02 vs 18.03, Z8S top 19.99 vs 19.89). Photos: none found. Spec audit 21 Oct 2026: all engine figures confirmed

cars.notes: Renamed: the XUV700 has been replaced by the facelifted XUV 7XO (feature article dated Jan 2026). The id is kept as mahindra-xuv700 as instructed. 27 variants. Prices are CarDekho lakh figures converted to rupees; the range Rs 13.99-25.79 lakh matches Autocar India. Conflict: Autocar's text gives the AX3 petrol AT at Rs 17.79 lakh vs CarDekho's Rs 17.88 lakh. Mahindra's site could not be read. No ARAI figures are published for the 7XO (Autocar: 'yet to be published'). The mileage shown is the XUV700's ARAI figures as quoted by Autocar (petrol MT 15, AT 13; diesel MT 17, AT 16.57), since the 200 PS petrol and 185 PS/420-450 Nm diesel are carried over. AWD is left null. Petrol power is 200 PS (~200 bhp @ 5000 rpm) per CarDekho and listings but 203 hp per Autocar. Diesel MT torque rpm was not found. Wheels: CarDekho says AX5 gets 17-inch styled steel wheels, but Autocar says alloys start at AX5. AX7T wheel size is not stated. AX7T/AX7L airbag count of 7 rests on the added knee airbag and Autocar's 'tops out with 7 airbags'. Autocar's variants page labels the base trim 'AX2' while other pages use 'AX'. Update 21 Oct 2026: prices re-checked against CarDekho (all 27 unchanged). CarWale (Mumbai) lists more variants (44) and different trim floors (AX7 from 18.63, AX7T from 21.14, AX7L from 22.62 lakh vs CarDekho 19.26/21.79/23.40); its extra variants were not added, and tops match (21.16, 23.99, 25.79). AWD mileage stays null: no ARAI figure is published (CarWale says Mahindra has not revealed 7XO figures; only road tests exist). Rushlane's test mentions a 65 L tank vs 60 L here (not changed). No photos found. Update 21 Oct 2026: photos added from Wikimedia Commons (found via Openverse); labelled where they show an older look or another market. Spec audit 21 Oct 2026: p20 cylinders null -> 4; 2.2 diesel cc 2184 -> 2198 (CarDekho XUV700 lists 2198; Thar uses 2184 variant). d22-mt torque rpm still unconfirmed.

cars.notes: Line-up updated in 2026 with RevX M/M(O), RevX Edge/Edge(O) (Sept 2026) and the CNG ('ZNG'), launched 15 Oct 2026 with deliveries from 20 Oct. Older MX2 Pro, MX3 and MX3 Pro trims are gone. EV (XUV 3XO EV) is skipped. 31 variants. Trims are not a strict ladder: there are parallel MX, RevX and AX lines, so they are ordered by starting price and each feature list is relative to the nearest lower trim in its line (as CarDekho and Autocar describe them). The CNG runs on the 1.2 TCMPFi engine with the same 111 PS/200 Nm as on petrol, per Autocar, and is certified at 24.7 km/kg. Mileage is CarDekho's ARAI listing. TCMPFi AT is 17.96 kmpl in most listings, but CarDekho's RevX M(O) AT row shows 18.89. The RevX Edge (O) diesel AMT figure is not listed, so the 21.2 kmpl powertrain figure is used. TCMPFi and diesel rpm figures are from Wikipedia and launch reports. Cylinder counts for the TCMPFi and diesel, and diesel gearbox speeds, are not confirmed. Feature conflict: CarDekho says RevX M(O) adds a single-pane sunroof, but one Autocar variant page shows a panoramic sunroof. Several mid-trim wheel sizes are not stated (null). Mahindra's site could not be read. Update 21 Oct 2026: prices re-checked against CarDekho and CarWale; all 31 unchanged (CarWale's summary gives AX7L from 13.33 vs 13.32 in its own table). Mileage unchanged. No new rear photo found. Spec audit 21 Oct 2026: p12 cylinders null -> 3, d15 cylinders null -> 4. CNG variants on p12 confirmed (Mahindra: same 111 hp/200 Nm on CNG). Other figures confirmed.

cars.notes: 5-door Thar ROXX only (the 3-door Thar/Thar OG is excluded). No facelift; the Star Edition (Jan 2026, cosmetic, RWD only, no ADAS) has been added. 21 variants. Prices are CarDekho lakh figures converted to rupees; Autocar shows the same 21 variants (on-road). Mahindra's site could not be read. Engine tunes: petrol 162 PS/330 Nm (MT) and 177 PS/380 Nm (AT). Diesel is 152 PS/330 Nm on all manuals and MX automatics, and 175 PS/370 Nm on AX5L and AX7L automatics (Autocar, CarDekho). bhp figures are CarDekho's. Rpm figures are from carcentral.in. The Star Edition diesel AT tune is not confirmed; CarDekho's launch story says only 'up to 175 PS'. Autocar's spec page lists the diesel at 175 hp/400 Nm @ 1750-2750, conflicting with the 370 Nm stated elsewhere. Diesel displacement is 2184 cc per carcentral and 2198 cc per Autocar. Mileage (12.4 petrol, 15.2 diesel) is CarDekho's ARAI listing, and Autocar also shows 15.2. Feature conflicts: CarDekho says AX5L gets a panoramic sunroof, but Autocar says single-pane, so the AX5L entry just says 'Sunroof'. Autocar's MX3 list oddly includes adaptive cruise control, which is not used here. MX1 airbags are 6 per CarDekho's variant and safety sections (one summary line says dual). Wheel sizes for MX3, AX3L and AX5L are not stated. Update 21 Oct 2026: front photo replaced with the cropped version of the same Commons image (car fills the frame); rear still missing. Prices re-checked against CarDekho (all 21 unchanged). CarWale (Mumbai) lists 28 variants with slightly different figures (MX3 from 15.39 vs 15.28, AX3L 17.40 vs 17.28, MX5 top 19.56 vs 19.42, AX7L from 19.52 vs 19.57 lakh); CarDekho New Delhi kept. Mileage unchanged. Spec audit 21 Oct 2026: d22-star-at power/torque null -> 172 bhp @3500, 370 Nm @1500-3000 (CarWale/Rushlane: diesel AT = 175 PS/370 Nm). Conflicts: some sources give 400 Nm for diesel AT; CarWale says all diesel ATs get 175 PS while Autocar says only AX5L/AX7L AT, so lower AT variants left on 152 PS tune.
